document.abstract: The Atlanta Section met on March 14 for a barbecue dinner provided by Canon, and a program titled “Digital Camera's Challenge, which explored technological advancements in the digital camera field. Chuck Luzier was the presenter. Still cameras now record moving images and video cameras have the ability to make still shots. Luzier addressed the continued problems of audio recording and synchronization, as well as single camera usage, multicamera usage, and editing challenges with current solutions and expected technology advances. A variety of camera and recorder products were displayed and were also available for “hands-on” demonstration after the meeting.
